recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓切片的骨小樑之間塞滿灰白色、呈放射狀星芒排列的針狀結晶，外圍有密集紅染的纖維及梭形細胞，造血組織幾乎不見，指向骨髓草酸鹽沉積（oxalosis）。
features: Bone marrow core with trabecular bone at the lower left and edges
Intertrabecular space filled with gray-white needle-shaped crystals in stellate/radiating clusters
Dense surrounding fibrous tissue with spindle cells and probable foreign-body reaction
Marked depletion of hematopoietic tissue and fat
describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow biopsy at low power shows the intertrabecular marrow largely replaced by gray-white, needle-shaped crystals arranged in stellate and radiating clusters, embedded in dense eosinophilic fibrous tissue with spindle cells. Normal hematopoietic tissue and marrow fat are markedly reduced in the involved area. The image resolution limits evaluation of individual cells. Findings are consistent with marrow oxalosis, which should prompt evaluation for primary hyperoxaluria or secondary hyperoxalosis in renal failure.

ddx.vs: Metastatic deposits contain cohesive atypical epithelial cells confirmable with keratin immunostains rather than acellular crystal rosettes.

ddx.dx: Fibrotic marrow in myelofibrosis or renal osteodystrophy
ddx.vs: These show fibrosis and trabecular remodeling but lack extracellular refractile crystalline sheaves that polarize.
Tophi show amorphous pale material with a palisading histiocytic rim, as urate crystals dissolve in routine processing unlike persistent oxalate rosettes.
